blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source identity
The preserved source is a mobile top-down trick-riding arcade game. It starts directly in play, uses a left joystick to accelerate a small avatar around a large bounded world, launches from rectangular ramps, allows three trick buttons only while airborne, awards score for clean landing after combo tricks, bounces off obstacles, and uses an end/restart overlay.

## Protected mechanics
- Continuous free-roam movement with acceleration, friction, speed cap, camera follow, and world clamp.
- Left-half virtual joystick input and right-side three-button action cluster.
- Launch collision when moving fast through rectangular ramp-like objects.
- Air state, gravity, z-height, trick timer, trick rotation, clean/stumble landing semantics.
- Combo scoring: combo count times 100 on clean landing only.
- Obstacle collision as bounce/pop, not lethal damage.
- End quest/gameover and restart state flow.

## Transformable surfaces
Title, HUD words, avatar drawing, ramp/hazard visuals, particles, background, fonts, audio choices, overlay copy, control labels, and progression framing.

## Rebuilt target
Relic of the Verdant Gate: a portrait-first mythic overworld adventure where a shield hero crosses sigil gates and uses relic items in the air to bind rune light.
